Thank you for visiting our showroom last week. We are glad that you have chosen Maple Lane Furniture for your home furnishing needs. I've gone through our current second-hand inventory and have created {{1}}. Please see attached.

All the pieces except the fourth one have {{2}}, as indicated. All of the pieces {{3}}. Since you feel strongly about staying within a tight budget, I am also going to check our warehouse on Monday to see what else has come in. I will send you the details afterwards. {{5}}, please let me know if you'd like to come in and view any of these four pieces this weekend.

Sandra
